summary: Iteration-8: tested the new Live Chat Button + Support ticket feature end-to-end. Backend: added TestIter8SupportTickets (17 pytest tests) covering create/validation/auth, listing + cross-user 404, admin filter+search + 403 for non-admin, user vs admin reply flows (status transitions open→answered, unread flags flip, buyer notification 'Support replied'), GET clears unread, close blocks user reply with 400 (admin can still reply), reopen allows user reply, admin stats pending.tickets. 17/17 pass against the public URL. Frontend (Playwright on wallet-goods.preview.emergentagent.com): logged-out ChatButton visible on /shop with href=/login; buyer sees it on /shop /wallet /vault and NOT on /support; admin never sees it. Click → /support?new=1 with new-ticket-form; submit → ticket-thread-<id>, status 'open', TCK-xxxx ref assigned; buyer reply via ticket-reply-input/send adds second message. Admin panel: admin-tab-tickets with admin-tab-count-tickets badge, filters tickets-filter-{open,answered,closed,all} present, admin-tickets-search finds ticket by subject; admin thread shows user email, admin reply flips status to 'answered', ticket-close-btn → 'closed', ticket-reopen-btn → 'open'. Buyer side after admin reply: live-chat-unread badge rendered, ticket-unread-<id> dot visible on /support, admin message labelled 'Support team', ticket-closed-note visible on closed ticket and ticket-reply-input absent (reply blocked). account-link-support present. Mobile 390: button sits at bottom:711 above bottom-nav top:780 (no overlap).
critical_code_review_comments: ChatButton unread count uses /tickets which excludes messages but includes closed tickets, so a closed ticket whose unread_user flag was never cleared still bumps the red badge indefinitely. Consider either (a) clearing unread_user on admin close in server.py (admin_ticket_status) or (b) filtering `t.status !== 'closed'` in ChatButton's unread computation. Not a correctness bug per spec, but could surprise buyers whose only unread was a 'closed by admin' ticket they never opened.

Backend `_ticket_for(tid, user)` for admin uses {'id': tid} without a user_id scope — good. But `admin_ticket_status` calls it and then references t['user_id'] for audit/notify, so admin acting on a non-existent ticket raises 404 correctly. No change needed.

server.py:1141 uses find_one_and_update with $push + $set — unread_admin/unread_user flip is race-free; good. Minor: when admin replies to a 'closed' ticket, status is set to 'answered' which effectively reopens it silently. Consider either preserving 'closed' (admin reply doesn't reopen) or returning a clear 'ticket reopened' side-effect; current behavior may confuse admins who closed then added a parting note.

ChatButton fetches /tickets on every pathname change for every logged-in buyer/vendor — fine for now but a notifications polling / websocket channel would be more efficient; also unread_user flag update is only observed on route change, not after admin replies arrive while the buyer is idle on /shop.
Resend email failure on admin reply is logged only (per spec) — fine; verified via test_admin_reply_sets_answered_and_notifies_user that in-app notification is created regardless. No change needed.

Support.jsx builds `creating` from `sp.get('new') === '1' || (list && !list.length && !active)` — if a buyer has 0 tickets, the form auto-shows which is nice, but then clicking 'Cancel' calls setSp({}) and the auto-rule immediately re-opens the form. Minor UX nit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Support ticket endpoints: POST /api/tickets {subject(3-120), topic in {General,Deposit,Order,Vendor,Account}, message(1-4000), order_id?}; GET /api/tickets (own, no messages field); GET /api/tickets/{tid} (own OR admin, clears unread flag of caller role); POST /api/tickets/{tid}/messages (user: 400 if closed; admin: flips status to 'answered' and sends notify title='Support replied'); GET /api/admin/tickets?status=open|answered|closed|all&q=... (admin only, 403 otherwise); POST /api/admin/tickets/{tid}/status {status: open|closed}. Admin stats pending.tickets counts status==open. Frontend testids: live-chat-button, live-chat-unread, new-ticket-form, new-ticket-subject, new-ticket-topic, new-ticket-message, new-ticket-submit, new-ticket-cancel, tickets-list, ticket-row-<id>, ticket-unread-<id>, ticket-thread-<id>, ticket-subject, ticket-status, ticket-reply-input, ticket-reply-send, ticket-close-btn, ticket-reopen-btn, ticket-closed-note, support-back, support-new-btn, admin-tab-tickets, admin-tab-count-tickets, tickets-filter-{open,answered,closed,all}, admin-tickets-search, account-link-support. ChatButton hidden when user.role==='admin' OR pathname startsWith '/support'. Captcha testid data-testid=login-captcha-question is an sr-only span alongside the canvas; still contains plain text question for test automation.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Only soft improvement surfaced: closed tickets with unread_user=true keep inflating ChatButton's red badge forever since admin_ticket_status does not reset unread flags. Suggested server.py fix: in admin_ticket_status when body.status=='closed', add 'unread_user': False to the $set so the buyer badge decrements once admin resolves the ticket. Alternatively filter closed tickets in ChatButton. Not blocking - the feature meets the stated spec.
